summary: Per-host capability certification canary runner added (REQ-011/REQ-018); all eight registry hosts probed live; five hosts live-probed, three NOT_LIVE_VERIFIED. Per-capability LIVE_CERTIFIED remains fail-closed and requires explicit confirmation.

evidence.claim: Per-host capability certification canary binds registry v2 static facts with live binary probes and emits HostCapabilityFacts with honest certifications.
evidence.proof: packages/kernel/src/northstar/host-canary.ts runHostCanary; packages/cli/src/commands/host-canary.ts; live probes: codex 0.148.0, claude 2.1.237, opencode 1.18.18, deepseek-harness 0.1.0-rc.7, command-code 1.28.4 -> live-probed; cursor/antigravity/grok absent -> NOT_LIVE_VERIFIED.
evidence.verifier: kernel host-canary.test.ts (6 tests); cli host-canary.test.ts (4 tests); live CLI run on all 8 hosts

evidence.claim: Fingerprint change re-probes immediately and stales only dependent certifications; per-capability LIVE_CERTIFIED requires explicit confirmation (never binary-detection only).
evidence.proof: staleCertifications + capabilityIsLive in host-capabilities.ts; host-canary emits per-capability STATIC_CONFORMED unless confirmed in the probe.
evidence.verifier: enforcement.test.ts REQ-011 suite; host-canary.test.ts fail-closed assertions

omitted.reason: Existing per-host adapters (claude/codex/opencode/cursor/antigravity/grok) are already rich; P4 remaps them onto the shared HostAdapter contract through the compatibility shim and the canary runner, rather than rewriting each from scratch.

Binary live probes prove the host runs; per-capability LIVE_CERTIFIED requires explicit capability confirmation (e.g. permission deny canary, sandbox mutation canary) which is gated for the live certification stage.

residual_risk: Capability-specific live canaries (permission deny, sandbox mutation, worktree isolate) still require explicit confirmation probes.
